// In the separately built trusted executable SessionBridge phase switch:
// pluginDir must contain only fixed HostBudgetProbe.Payload/Private IL.
// evidenceDir must be a new writable app-owned path for each owned launch.
// nonce is generated by the trusted operator and bound to the native PID receipt.
case "host-budget":
    return MobileHostBudgetProbe.Entry.Run(new[] {
        Path.Combine(docs, "budget-plugin"),
        Path.Combine(docs, "budget-evidence-" + ownedNonce),
        ownedNonce,
        "all"
    });
